item.title: Gas price spike spurs a political blame game in California
item.summary: California's gas prices have long been high, and spikes due to the war with Iran have sparked debate over who's to blame. Some Democrats say Gov. Gavin Newsom could do more to ease prices.

item.title: Mamdani put Ramadan at the center of NYC's cultural life, bringing joy -- and a backlash
item.summary: NYC Mayor Mamdani observed Ramadan publicly at a time when many politicians and activists on the right are voicing hostility and in some cases open bigotry toward American Muslims.

item.title: FAA tightens safety rules for helicopters and planes around major airports
item.summary: Regulators at the Federal Aviation Administration are tightening safety rules in congested airspace around major airports, suspending the use of visual separation between planes and helicopters.

item.title: Trump temporarily waives the Jones Act to try to lower gasoline prices. Will it work?
item.summary: The Jones Act restricts which ships can carry goods between U.S. ports. Experts say temporarily lifting the act will do little to affect gas prices.

item.title: Greetings from Nyeri, Kenya, where grandmothers help coach the next generation
item.summary: A group of grandmothers in central Kenya have formed a soccer team to keep fit and to give hope to a generation of teenagers — whom they sometimes outrun on the field.

item.title: Cesar Chavez abused and raped women and girls, NYT investigation says
item.summary: A New York Times investigation has revealed allegations that the late renowned labor leader abused girls and raped Dolores Huerta, his longtime organizing partner.

item.title: A mom wrote a kids' book on grief. She was just convicted of her husband's murder
item.summary: A Utah jury convicted Kouri Richins of fatally spiking her husband's drink with fentanyl in 2022. Prosecutors said she was hoping to collect millions of dollars from multiple life insurance policies.

item.title: Six seasons and a sequel: 'Peaky Blinders' is easy to consume and impossible to forget
item.summary: Tommy Shelby's estranged son has taken control of the old gang and is making new and dangerous moves and alliances. Cillian Murphy stars in this gripping movie-length Peaky Blinders sequel.

item.title: A mysterious floral artist has taken over the New York Botanical Garden
item.summary: Mr. Flower Fantastic is a graffiti artist turned floral designer who keeps his identity a secret. His new show is an ode to NYC in orchids. Oh, and did we mention he's allergic to flowers?

item.title: These roaches form exclusive long-term relationships after eating each other's wings
item.summary: Salganea taiwanensis, a kind of wood-feeding cockroach, may engage in what's known as pair bonding, a new study finds.
